column8: key_learning
Baseline establishment
A time-scheduled pre-activation WRN-16-4 converts H20 headroom into a 3.11-point CIFAR-10 gain within the fixed budget.
Front-loaded probabilistic CutMix adds 0.61 points to the time-aware WRN while preserving throughput and clean late convergence.
Higher CutMix looked favorable in selected search runs but failed confirmation, exposing variance rather than a reliable regularization gain.
Period-two SAM in the clean final quarter adds 0.17 points while preserving 25,560 optimizer steps and exact parent RNG semantics.
Half-overlap DLB preserved step throughput and lowered test loss, but halved new-image exposure and reduced accuracy by 0.12 points.
Replacing one quarter of validated CutMix exposure with low-dose manifold mixup leaves accuracy within noise and worsens final test loss.
Published-default late ASAM preserved throughput but missed by 0.06 points; its first perturbation had 9x the parent Euclidean norm.
Exact paired RandAugment was reproducible, but its best loader rate stayed below parent worst; accuracy was never tested.
Four active FP32 SE gates preserved parent semantics but added 20.7% median step latency; accuracy was never tested.
Moving one equal-MAC block from stage 1 to stage 3 raised steps 9.3% but produced no detectable accuracy improvement.
A full-state clean-tail EMA reached 95.61% with negligible charged overhead, but its 95.49% tail plateau limits causal certainty.
Full-probability complementary Cutout reached 95.52 with a lower 95.42 tail, but step under-dose prevents a clean full-dose causal conclusion.
Fixed-scale-40 cosine normalization preserved full training dose but lowered best accuracy by 0.50 points and the EMA tail by 0.42 points.
